subject: object of type 'closure' is not subsettable data

messages.author: b78d2def28945832
messages.subject: object of type 'closure' is not subsettable data
parts:
Hi all, 

When using the following code outside of R markdown, I have no issues, but when trying to knit my data I keep getting this error :  

data <- data1[!is.na(data1$consent),]  # remove those who didn't consent by not answering
data <- (data1[!(data1$consent==0),]) # remove those who didn't consent by saying no

# Drop those who didn't complete all the questionnaires 
data <- data1 %>% drop_na(ADHD.Diagnosis)

data <- data1 %>% drop_na(ASRS_Total) 

data <- data1 %>% drop_na(SCS_Total_Mean) 

data[data1 == -99] <- NA # turn -99 into missing data
sum(is.na(data$PCrit_1)) # 44 people did not complete PCRIT 
data <- data1 %>% drop_na(PCrit_1) # remove the people who did not complete the measure



Can anyone help me understand why or what I need to do to amend it? 

Thanks
Danielle

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: object of type 'closure' is not subsettable data
parts: If data1 is a reactive expression, then the way to read it is data1(), not data1. e.g. instead of data1[!is.na(data1$consent),] it'd be data1()[!is.na(data1()$consent),]
